inputs.text:
# Week 1
## Chest and Calves
// Pyramid up in weight each set. Increase when it feels manageable.
pyramid / used: none / 1x12, 1x10, 1x8 / progress: custom() {~
  for (var.i in reps) { weights[var.i] = completedWeights[var.i] }
~}

// ...pyramid
Incline Chest Press, Leverage Machine / ...pyramid / 100lb / 60s
// ...pyramid
Bench Press, Dumbbell / ...pyramid / 40lb / 60s
// ...pyramid
Incline Chest Fly / ...pyramid / 20lb / 60s
Chest Dip / 3x10 / 0lb / 90s / progress: dp(5lb, 10, 12)
Decline Bench Press, Smith Machine / 3x10 / 115lb / 90s / progress: dp(5lb, 10, 12)
Standing Calf Raise / 3x12 / 90lb / 60s / progress: dp(5lb, 12, 15)
Seated Calf Raise / 3x12 / 70lb / 60s / progress: dp(5lb, 12, 15)

## Triceps and Biceps
// Pyramid up in weight each set. Increase when it feels manageable.
pyramid2 / used: none / 1x15, 1x12, 1x10 / progress: custom() { ...pyramid }

// ...pyramid2
Triceps Pushdown / ...pyramid2 / 40lb / 60s
// Straight bar attachment. Pyramid up in weight each set.
bar: Triceps Pushdown / ...pyramid2 / 40lb / 60s
// ...pyramid
Bench Press Close Grip / ...pyramid / 115lb / 120s
// ...pyramid
Triceps Dip, Leverage Machine / ...pyramid / 70lb / 60s
// ...pyramid
Skullcrusher / ...pyramid / 40lb / 60s
// Single arm, reverse grip. Pyramid up in weight each set.
reverse: Triceps Pushdown / ...pyramid / 20lb / 60s
// ...pyramid2
Bicep Curl / ...pyramid2 / 20lb / 60s
// ...pyramid2
Incline Curl / ...pyramid2 / 15lb / 60s
// ...pyramid2
Preacher Curl, Barbell / ...pyramid2 / 55lb / 60s
// ...pyramid
Hammer Curl / ...pyramid / 25lb / 60s
// ...pyramid
Lying Bicep Curl, Cable / ...pyramid / 30lb / 60s

## Back
// Underhand grip
underhand: Lat Pulldown / 3x8 / 100lb / 90s / progress: dp(5lb, 8, 10)
Lat Pulldown / 3x10 / 100lb / 90s / progress: dp(5lb, 10, 12)
Deadlift / 3x6 / 225lb / 120s / progress: dp(10lb, 6, 8)
T Bar Row / 3x8 / 90lb / 90s / progress: dp(5lb, 8, 10)
Bent Over One Arm Row / 3x10 / 30lb / 60s / progress: dp(5lb, 10, 12)
Bent Over Row / 3x10 / 95lb / 90s / progress: dp(5lb, 10, 12)
Seated Row / 3x10 / 100lb / 60s / progress: dp(5lb, 10, 12)

## Delts and Traps
Lateral Raise / 3x10 / 15lb / 60s / progress: dp(5lb, 10, 12)
Overhead Press, Dumbbell / 3x8 / 30lb / 90s / progress: dp(5lb, 8, 10)
Shoulder Press, Leverage Machine / 3x10 / 70lb / 60s / progress: dp(5lb, 10, 12)
Reverse Fly, Leverage Machine / 3x10 / 40lb / 60s / progress: dp(5lb, 10, 12)
Shrug / 3x10 / 40lb / 60s / progress: dp(5lb, 10, 12)
Upright Row, Barbell / 3x10 / 65lb / 60s / progress: dp(5lb, 10, 12)

## Quads, Hamstrings, and Calves
// Light activation sets
activation: Leg Extension / 2x12-15 / 40lb / 60s / warmup: none
Squat / 3x8 / 185lb / 120s / progress: dp(10lb, 8, 10)
Leg Press / 3x10 / 200lb / 90s / progress: dp(10lb, 10, 12)
Lunge, Dumbbell / 3x10 / 25lb / 60s / progress: dp(5lb, 10, 12)
Hack Squat / 3x10 / 140lb / 90s / progress: dp(10lb, 10, 12)
Leg Extension / 3x12 / 80lb / 60s / progress: dp(5lb, 12, 15)
Seated Leg Curl / 3x10 / 60lb / 60s / progress: dp(5lb, 10, 12)
Lying Leg Curl / 3x10 / 60lb / 60s / progress: dp(5lb, 10, 12)
Romanian Deadlift, Barbell / 3x8 / 135lb / 90s / progress: dp(5lb, 8, 10)
Single Leg Deadlift / 3x10 / 30lb / 60s / progress: dp(5lb, 10, 12)
Hip Abductor / 3x10 / 80lb / 60s / progress: dp(5lb, 10, 12)
Hip Adductor / 3x10 / 80lb / 60s / progress: dp(5lb, 10, 12)
Standing Calf Raise / 3x12 / 90lb / 60s
Seated Calf Raise / 3x12 / 70lb / 60s
